label: TP
reason: A user-controlled parameter from request.getParameterValues("BenchmarkTest01572") flows into the bar variable via the ThingInterface doSomething method, then directly into the file path construction as "org.owasp.benchmark.helpers.Utils.TESTFILES_DIR + bar". This creates a path traversal vulnerability where untrusted input can lead to arbitrary file access.

evidence.note: User input from request parameter flows through doSomething() and is used to construct a file path without validation or sanitization
